title.en: An Act Confirming and Validating the Action of the stockholders and Officers of the Manila Hotel Company in Issuing the Last Five Hundred Shares of Capital stock of Said Corporation.

text.en:
The action of the stockholders and officers of the Manila Hotel Company in issuing its last five
hundred shares of capital stock, thereby increasing its issued capital stock to four hundred and fifty thousand
pesos, is hereby approved, ratified, confirmed, and in all respects declared legal; and the articles of
incorporation of said corporation are hereby amended accordingly.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
